request: Owner, 23 Nov, a screenshot of the cabinet road (/portal, «Выбор программы»): «вот этих, что в кругляшках milestones, делай, короче, тоже мозаичными. И вот та самая первая иллюстрация, где Веспи смотрит на карту, она слишком простая. Вот играй с тем свободным пространством и сделай ее более такой, ну, в целом итальянской, и в целом более креативной… playing with the open space there, so it would look so much more immersive.»

references: ee72350f-7627-4ed2-98ea-eb9bf1aef589 (the old vespi-map, for the series' look)
vespi-atlas.scene: Vespi kneels at the edge of a huge unfolded paper map with a pencil; the Italy of the road rises out of the paper as a handmade model (felt Tuscan hills and cypresses, a clay Colosseum, Florence's dome, a Venetian bridge over a resin canal, a leaning tower, olive trees) and a dotted terracotta route runs from his pencil across it; his red scooter at the map's left edge.

other_concepts.scene: Tuscan crossroads: Vespi with the map by the scooter, a white road winding through cypresses to a hill town, a blank signpost
a hilltop belvedere: Vespi leans on a stone balustrade with the map, a lemon tree in a pot, the valley below
a cypress avenue: Vespi on the scooter with the map on the handlebars at the start of the road

vespi-atlas.why: The map that becomes Italy is the stage itself (choosing where to study) and draws the road's own dotted route; the other three are landscapes, as the old piece was.
